name: Lavaine
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Lavaine is a minor character in the tales of Arthur. He is the brother of Elaine. He is also a friend of Lancelot. He moves through the later stories of the court. His part is small but he stands with the main knights in many scenes.

okr.objective: Give the minor role of Lavaine in the Arthurian tales.
key_results: He is the brother of Elaine.
He is a friend of Lancelot.
